parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The modified subscription objects, in JSON format. For more information about the definition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html.
The new DbList value overwrites the original DbList value. Make sure that the new DbList value contains all the objects that you want to track. Otherwise, objects may be lost. Modify this parameter with caution.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html to query the original subscription objects
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的订阅对象，格式为JSON串。详细定义，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html。
原DbList会被新传入的DbList覆盖，请确保新传入的DbList数据中包含所有需要订阅的对象，否则可能会导致订阅对象丢失，请谨慎修改。
原订阅对象，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html进行查询
parameters.name: db_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID

parameters.help_en:

true: The task subscribes to DDL data.
false: The task does not subscribe to DDL data

true：是。
false：否
